# SD18 deterministic Human Cleric level 15 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Cleric
# level-1..level-14 prepared divine spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/fixtures/rules_core/pf1_human_cleric_level14_sd18_widening_deterministic_input.txt)
# to level 15 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic
# ability/feat posture from the level-1 through level-14 fixtures, and the
# same canonical domain selections (Good, Healing), adding only the level
# bump this bounded slice needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Cleric burden surface: no spellbook, no
# spells prepared, no spell slots, no spell DCs, no bonus spells, no domain
# power execution beyond the flat facets already grounded at levels 1-14, no
# domain spell-list contents, and no level-16+ progression. The PF1 CRB
# Cleric class table's level-15 "Special" column reads "Channel energy 8d6"
# (verified independently against d20pfsrd and the Archives of Nethys
# aonprd.com mirror, both agreeing, and cross-checked against
# legacy.aonprd.com's raw spells-per-day table rows for the domain-slot
# threshold question): base attack bonus genuinely rises to +11
# (15 * 3 / 4 = 11, up from 10 at level 14), base Reflex (poor save)
# genuinely rises to +5 (15 / 3 = 5, up from 4), base Fortitude/Will (good
# saves) stay +9 (15 / 2 + 2 = 9, an integer-division coincidence with level
# 14), Channel Energy's die count genuinely rises to 8d6
# ((15 + 1) / 2 = 8, up from 7d6 at level 14) via the same pre-existing
# formula, not re-derived, and the flat domain spell slot count genuinely
# rises to 8 (a level-15 cleric casts 8th-level cleric spells for the first
# time, verified against legacy.aonprd.com's raw spells-per-day table row:
# the 8th-level column is "—" through level 14 and first shows "1+1" at
# level 15). The Good domain's Touch of Good sacred bonus stays 7
# (15 / 2 = 7, an integer-division coincidence with level 14).
case_id=pf1-crb-human-cleric-level15
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:cleric:15
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:14
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:good
choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:healing
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
